text:
support_josh: Heads-up — customer acct-9876 filed a ticket after last night's deploy. Their nightly image-embed backfill hit 429s repeatedly. They say ~80 parallel workers, 5s intervals, ~2k tokens/s sustained for ~8m. Response body includes 'burst_cushion_exhausted'.

mira_oncall: Can you paste a sample response and the exact timestamps? Also whether they're on Hosted/Dedicated.

support_josh: Sample response from the client at 2026-03-16T03:12:46Z:
```json
{"error":"rate_limit","message":"burst cushion exhausted","code":429}
```
ops-bot: alert: burst_credit_balance acct-9876 dropped from 1200 -> 0 at 03:12:45 UTC (ingested by billing-proc-3).

alex_sre: They're on Hosted paid plan (no Dedicated). 80 workers @5s = a lot of concurrency. Burst credits are for short spikes; sustained load eats the cushion fast.

customer: For context — we run a cron to re-embed images after transform. It used to be fine, only started after we increased concurrency to speed up backfill. We expected burst credits to cover it.

mira_oncall: Quick triage: 1) confirm burst remaining header in their responses `x-rw-burst-remaining` 2) ask them to add jitter/backoff 3) suggest batch embeddings if supported.

support_josh: Confirmed they saw `x-rw-burst-remaining: 0` and `x-rw-retry-after: 8`. They reported many simultaneous 429s instead of graceful staggered retries.

alex_sre: Immediate workaround we gave: reduce parallelism to 10-15 workers, add exponential backoff with jitter, or add a 200ms random sleep between starts. Also recommend batching images into fewer requests so per-request token rate lowers.

sylvia_prod: Long-term: product should document backfill patterns and an explicit "prewarm / reserve" API or short-term burst top-up for large backfills. Also consider adding guidance in Console to show estimated burst consumption for a planned job.

mira_oncall: Also noting smoothing policy: our burst smoothing window favors short bursts; sustained 8+ minutes will not be smoothed. We should surface that in support responses.

support_josh: I shared repro guidance with the customer and a step-by-step rollback:
- stop full concurrency job
- drain current workers
- run with concurrency=12 and 500ms jitter for a 10m window
- check `x-rw-burst-remaining` after 2 mins and 10 mins

customer: Trying the reduced concurrency now, will report back in ~20m. Thanks. :relieved:

alex_sre: FYI infra notes: we observed a burst billing job miscalculation once where credits were attributed to a secondary org id for ~90s — I opened ENG-5501 to investigate accounting races. Could explain sudden zeroing in some edge cases.

ops-bot: ticket ENG-5501 created by alex_sre.

mira_oncall: Action items: 1) Support to follow up with customer outcome (support_josh) 2) SRE to check ENG-5501 and verify no double-attribution bug (alex_sre) 3) Product to add backfill guidance & consider prewarm option (sylvia_prod).

support_josh: I'll post a short KB entry with recommended worker configs and a sample backoff snippet. Posting to #docs-knowledge once done. :thumbsup:

customer: Update: throttling stopped after lowering concurrency. Backfill progressing at slower rate but no 429s. Thanks for the quick help.

mira_oncall: Great — closing loop. Please ping if the customer sees unexpected refill timing.

support_josh: Closing thread; KB PR filed (docs PR #342).
